proposal.name: commons-beanutils:commons-beanutils
proposal.rationale: The original name 'commons-beanutils' with null group did not match any Maven registry entry. The correct Maven coordinate is 'commons-beanutils:commons-beanutils' (groupId:artifactId). Version 1.9.4 was confirmed to exist in the registry (E2, E3) and matches the declared version in the SBOM.
